name: Tournament 9
notes: STANDALONE — no league standings, so no season.
'Random wheel' format: pairings drawn at random rather than seeded.
The ENTIRE surviving record is the top three, listed in the body of a forwarded email. There is no bracket, no full entrant list, no scores and no match data. Only the three medallists are imported.
Usernames are carried over from the standings sheets of other tournaments in which these same people appear.
